title: [Master] Different source reference on reservation entries created directly from Job Planning Line and via a warehouse pick.
summary: Reservation entries for project (job) planning lines now get the same source reference whether they are created directly or through a warehouse or inventory pick. The change touches project warehouse handling, pick creation and posting, and adds upgrade code with upgrade tags for existing data.
key_points: Fixes different source references on reservation entries created from Job Planning Line and via warehouse pick
Updates Job Warehouse Mgt., Job Planning Line, pick creation, and warehouse activity posting and registering
Adds upgrade code and upgrade tags across W1 and several local layers
Adds tests for inventory picks, warehouse picks and upgrade on project planning lines
